definitions.explanation: A wide sash worn around the waist to secure a kimono.
A strip or band wrapped around something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帯|おび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: To tie an obi around a kimono.
The book has a promotional band.

examples.japanese: {帯|おび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結|むす}び{方|かた}→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わからなくて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I didn't know how to tie the obi, so I had my mother help me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{帯|おび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{縛|しば}った→縛る：03925_shibaru⟧。
examples.english: I tied up the luggage tightly with a band.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帯|おび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦いちばん→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感動作|かんどうさく}→感動作：28168_kandousaku⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The promotional band on this novel says "The most moving work of the year."

notes:
{帯|おび} primarily refers to the traditional sash worn with kimono, but also has broader meanings.

KIMONO USAGE:
- {帯|おび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧ (to tie an obi)
- {帯|おび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧ (to tie/knot an obi)
- {帯|おび}⟦{締|じ}め→帯締め：noentry⟧ (obi fastener)

TYPES OF OBI:
- ⟦{袋帯|ふくろおび}→袋帯：noentry⟧ (formal double-folded obi)
- ⟦{名古屋帯|なごやおび}→名古屋帯：noentry⟧ (Nagoya obi - semi-formal)
- ⟦{半幅帯|はんはばおび}→半幅帯：noentry⟧ (half-width obi - casual)

OTHER MEANINGS:
- ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帯|おび} (book band - promotional strip)
- ⟦{周波数帯|しゅうはすうたい}→周波数帯：noentry⟧ (frequency band)

COUNTER:
- ⟦{本|ほん}→〜本：00688_hon⟧ for long items
